agent_readiness.notes: Findable 0: profile is flagged temporarily closed and missing phone, hours, website and category completeness. Answerable 0: no readable services or prices. Bookable 0: no booking channel and no active business to book.

operations_signals.signal: Listing state (temporarily closed, no phone) suggests the business stopped operating without updating its profile

top_opportunities.opportunity: No outreach recommended until operating status is confirmed; if it reopens, the first fix is claiming the profile and adding phone, hours, services and a booking link
top_opportunities.evidence: Google shows 'Temporarily closed' with no phone or website

scores.reasons: Gap 5: closed and unmanaged. Ability 1: no evidence of current trading. Ease 1: nothing can be delivered to a closed business. Evidence 2: Google state read directly, but the 'temporarily' wording and a live aggregator listing leave status ambiguous.

caveats: Google Maps served a limited view for every profile: star ratings were readable but review counts were not, so counts are quoted only where a second platform (Booksy, Birdeye) showed them, and those counts may not equal Google's.

Two sources of address ambiguity carried into the data: Madeth Bodycare's Google address is in New Brunswick 08901 while its Booksy listing resolves to North Brunswick 08902 (possibly a move or a second service area), and Planeta Nuevo's Booksy address field contains both 43 and 58 Georges Rd.

Swagger Barber Shop is marked operating because its Google listing shows hours and a rating, but its Booksy page has been deleted and the Google address field is corrupted, so current trading is not fully certain.
Dream Spa is marked closed on the strength of Google's 'Temporarily closed' flag; an aggregator still shows weekday hours, so this is the least certain status in the batch.
Booksy, Birdeye and directory reviews were used only as short summaries; no review text is quoted beyond a few words.

For businesses with no website, 'no site' findings come from the absence of a website field on their Google profile and from searches returning only directories - an owner could still have an unlinked site.
data_gaps: Google review counts could not be read for any business (Maps returned a reduced view without review totals).
Google Business Profile claim status was only observable where a 'Claim this business' prompt appeared (Victor's); for the others, claim status is inferred from the absence of the prompt.
Madeth Bodycare's domain could not be inspected beyond the browser TLS error and a failed plain-HTTP request, so it is unknown whether the site once existed or is parked.

Brunswick's Finest may have a live booking channel (one directory suggested a Booksy link that resolves to a different barber at the same address); it could not be confirmed, so it is recorded as no online booking.
Planeta Nuevo's phone number and any Google Business Profile could not be located; the business was confirmed only through Booksy.
No response, inquiry volume or staffing data was available for any business; operations signals are inferred from listings, reviews and site content and are labelled as such.
